conbody.p: Collision warning will alert the driver with the Forward Safety warning light () blinking, a warning message, an audible warning and steering wheel vibration.
Collision Warning will be activated in following conditions.

li.p: Your driving speed: Approximately 10–130 km/h (6–80 mph)
Crossing vehicle or powered two-wheeler speed: Approximately above 10 km/h (6 mph)
